========================================
Attribute-like macros in declaration specifiers
========================================

__IO uint32_t ISER[1];
__I uint8_t table[16];
__STATIC_INLINE q31_t clip(q31_t x) { return x; }
__ASM uint32_t __get_PSP(void);

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    (macro_attribute)
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (array_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      size: (number_literal)))
  (declaration
    (macro_attribute)
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (array_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      size: (number_literal)))
  (function_definition
    (macro_attribute)
    type: (type_identifier)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (type_identifier)
          declarator: (identifier))))
    body: (compound_statement
      (return_statement
        (identifier))))
  (declaration
    (macro_attribute)
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type))))))

========================================
Attribute-like macros around the declarator
========================================

VKAPI_ATTR VkBool32 VKAPI_CALL debugCallback(void *ud);
int WINAPI wWinMain(void *h, void *p, void *c, int s);

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    (macro_attribute)
    type: (type_identifier)
    (macro_attribute)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (pointer_declarator
            declarator: (identifier))))))
  (declaration
    type: (primitive_type)
    (macro_attribute)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (pointer_declarator
            declarator: (identifier)))
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (pointer_declarator
            declarator: (identifier)))
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (pointer_declarator
            declarator: (identifier)))
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (identifier))))))

========================================
All-caps declarator names stay declarators
========================================

int FOO;
uint32_t ISER[1];
__signed int sig;

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (identifier))
  (declaration
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (array_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      size: (number_literal)))
  (declaration
    type: (sized_type_specifier
      type: (primitive_type))
    declarator: (identifier)))

========================================
Diagnostic pragma macros stay statements
========================================

void f(void) {
  __diag_push();
  __diag_ignore("-Wunused");
  work();
  __diag_pop();
}
int g(void);

---

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type))))
    body: (compound_statement
      (expression_statement
        (call_expression
          function: (identifier)
          arguments: (argument_list)))
      (expression_statement
        (call_expression
          function: (identifier)
          arguments: (argument_list
            (string_literal
              (string_content)))))
      (expression_statement
        (call_expression
          function: (identifier)
          arguments: (argument_list)))
      (expression_statement
        (call_expression
          function: (identifier)
          arguments: (argument_list)))))
  (declaration
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type))))))

================================================================================
Calling-convention and pointer-model macros inside declarators
================================================================================

extern void* __cdecl memset(void*, int, size_t);
typedef VOID(NTAPI* PIO_APC_ROUTINE)(PVOID ApcContext, _In_ PIO_STATUS_BLOCK IoStatusBlock);
int f(fd_set FAR* s, char NEAR* d);
static char* __cdecl crt_lstrcpynA(char* dst, const char* src, int maxLen)
{
    return dst;
}
typedef CONST STRING* PCOEM_STRING;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(translation_unit
  (declaration
    (storage_class_specifier)
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (pointer_declarator
      (ms_call_modifier)

        declarator: (identifier)
        parameters: (parameter_list
          (parameter_declaration
            type: (primitive_type)
            declarator: (abstract_pointer_declarator))
          (parameter_declaration
            type: (primitive_type))
          (parameter_declaration
            type: (primitive_type))))))
  (type_definition
    type: (type_identifier)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (parenthesized_declarator
        (pointer_declarator
          (macro_attribute)
          declarator: (type_identifier)))
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (type_identifier)
          declarator: (identifier))
        (parameter_declaration
          (macro_qualifier
            (identifier))
          type: (type_identifier)
          declarator: (identifier)))))
  (declaration
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (type_identifier)
          declarator: (pointer_declarator
            (far_ptr_modifier)
            declarator: (identifier)))
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          declarator: (pointer_declarator
            (far_ptr_modifier)
            declarator: (identifier))))))
  (function_definition
    (storage_class_specifier)
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (pointer_declarator
      (ms_call_modifier)
      declarator: (function_declarator
        declarator: (identifier)
        parameters: (parameter_list
          (parameter_declaration
            type: (primitive_type)
            declarator: (pointer_declarator
              declarator: (identifier)))
          (parameter_declaration
            (type_qualifier)

            declarator: (pointer_declarator
              declarator: (identifier)))
          (parameter_declaration
            type: (primitive_type)
            declarator: (identifier)))))
    body: (compound_statement
      (return_statement

================================================================================
MSVC __asm block
================================================================================

void f() {
  __asm {
    push ecx
    mov eax, [ebx+4]
    cpuid
  }
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(translation_unit
  (function_definition
    (primitive_type)
    (function_declarator
      (identifier)
      (parameter_list))
    (compound_statement
      (ms_asm_statement
        (ms_asm_block
          (identifier)
          (identifier)
          (identifier)
          (identifier)
          (identifier)
          (number_literal)
          (identifier))))))
